title: Trade funding tooltip stays above adjacent panels

steps.expression: (() => { const trigger = document.querySelector("[data-role='active-asset-funding-trigger']"); if (!trigger) { return { scrolledIntoView: false, reason: "missing-trigger" }; } trigger.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" }); return { scrolledIntoView: true }; })()

(() => { const trigger = document.querySelector("[data-role='active-asset-funding-trigger']"); if (!trigger) { return { focused: false, reason: "missing-trigger" }; } trigger.focus(); return { focused: document.activeElement === trigger }; })()

(() => { const trigger = document.querySelector("[data-role='active-asset-funding-trigger']"); if (!trigger) { return { clicked: false, reason: "missing-trigger" }; } trigger.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const panel = document.querySelector("[data-role='active-asset-funding-tooltip']"); const trigger = document.querySelector("[data-role='active-asset-funding-trigger']"); const targets = { chart: document.querySelector("[data-parity-id='chart-panel']"), orderbook: document.querySelector("[data-parity-id='trade-orderbook-panel']"), account: document.querySelector("[data-parity-id='trade-account-tables-panel']") }; if (!panel || !trigger || Object.values(targets).some((node) => !node)) { return { panelPresent: Boolean(panel), triggerPresent: Boolean(trigger), chartPresent: Boolean(targets.chart), orderbookPresent: Boolean(targets.orderbook), accountPresent: Boolean(targets.account) }; } const rect = (node) => { const box = node.getBoundingClientRect(); return { left: box.left, top: box.top, right: box.right, bottom: box.bottom, width: box.width, height: box.height }; }; const clamp = (value, lower, upper) => Math.max(lower, Math.min(upper, value)); const panelRect = rect(panel); const samplePoint = (x, y) => { const element = document.elementFromPoint(x, y); const topDataRole = element?.closest("[data-role]")?.getAttribute("data-role") || null; const insidePanel = Boolean(element && panel.contains(element)); return { x, y, withinViewport: x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= window.innerWidth && y <= window.innerHeight, topDataRole, topOwnerRole: insidePanel ? "active-asset-funding-tooltip" : topDataRole, insidePanel }; }; const intersectionSample = (targetRect) => { const left = Math.max(panelRect.left, targetRect.left); const right = Math.min(panelRect.right, targetRect.right); const top = Math.max(panelRect.top, targetRect.top); const bottom = Math.min(panelRect.bottom, targetRect.bottom); return left < right && top < bottom ? samplePoint((left + right) / 2, (top + bottom) / 2) : null; }; const overlapSamples = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(targets).map(([name, node]) => { const targetRect = rect(node); const sample = intersectionSample(targetRect); return [name, { rect: targetRect, overlaps: Boolean(sample), sample }]; })); const ownsTooltip = (sample) => Boolean(sample && sample.insidePanel && sample.topOwnerRole === "active-asset-funding-tooltip"); const centerSample = samplePoint(clamp(panelRect.left + panelRect.width / 2, 1, window.innerWidth - 1), clamp(panelRect.top + panelRect.height / 2, 1, window.innerHeight - 1)); return { panelPresent: true, triggerPressed: trigger.getAttribute("aria-pressed"), triggerExpanded: trigger.getAttribute("aria-expanded"), panelPosition: getComputedStyle(panel).position, panelWithinViewport: panelRect.left >= 0 && panelRect.top >= 0 && panelRect.right <= window.innerWidth && panelRect.bottom <= window.innerHeight, panelRect, centerSample, chartOverlap: overlapSamples.chart.overlaps, intersectionOwners: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(overlapSamples).map(([name, { sample }]) => [name, sample ? ownsTooltip(sample) : true])), overlapSamples }; })()
